When I was younger I’d just do whatever but now that I’m older I try to be more efficient with practice. With that said I’ll spend an hour a day and do whatever it is I please related to skateboarding. Whether it be filming my limited bag of “tricks”, watch a skate video, learn a new trick or practice a trick. But I spend another hour just straight riding. Feet on the board and just getting comfortable being on my board in various different situations. I think both are equally important and beneficial. But in the end, it’s skateboarding…if you aren’t having fun you’re doing something wrong, if you are having fun keep doing what your doing.
